lines.t: My love, the beasts and birds just know That heavy weather's on its way
Don't count the exits, no, go alone Don't make your heart a barricade
I've sent my watchmen through the town They are replanted, seen and unseen
The proud will hear the young lion's sound And every wall falls in between
You don't have to outrun it
You don't have to stand alone
When the stone clouds start to gather
Wait for my servants at home
Hold on, hold on, let the hard sky break
You're not alone, you're not alone
A bearing trumpet shakes the gate
While cool rain falls where you make your home
Hold on, hold on, when the whole world shakes
You're not alone, you're not alone
I send them now, they will guard your place
And bring the second harvest home
For those who built their thrones on fear
Their hearts will tremble at my truth
My lions carry what it's due
Twin daggers piercing through and through
But you, my love, will feel the rain
A ten-year cool relief at once
A shelter from the summer blaze
A steady hand when day is done
You don't have to outrun it
You don't have to stand alone
When the storm clouds start to gather
Wait for my servants at home
Hold on, hold on
Let the hot sky break
You're not alone, you're not alone
A blaring trumpet shakes the gate
While cool rain falls
Where you make your home
Hold on, hold on
When the whole world shakes, you're not alone, you're not alone
I send them now, they will guard your place
And bring the second harvest home
My heart aches for what must break
I take no joy in what won't stay
Yet for the Father's and your sake
I send my lions through the fray
No panic, no lone running
No goodbye before the dawn
I've set my watchman at your door
I've guarded you all along
Hold on, hold on, let the hot sky break
You're not alone, you're not alone
A blaring trumpet shakes the gate
While cool rain falls where you make your home
Hold on, hold on, when the whole world shakes
You're not alone, you're not alone
I send them now, they will guard your place
And bring the second harvest home
Stay close my love
The rain is here
Stay close, my love
I'm near
